trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Compatible addmm shapes: mat1 [M, K], mat2 [K, N], bias/out [M, N].
trigger_condition.memory_trigger: out tensor aliases one of the input tensors, either directly or through a view sharing storage.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: out shape must be compatible with addmm output, and out must alias an input tensor, e.g., torch.addmm(t, t, weight, out=t).

bug_oracle.description: torch.addmm returns an all-zero tensor when out= aliases an input tensor instead of the expected result from non-aliased execution.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Test aliasing relationships by assigning out= to input tensors, views, slices, or tensors sharing storage.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct small dense tensors with compatible addmm shapes using simple values such as ones, eye, and zeros.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force out= to be one of the input tensors or a tensor that overlaps input storage.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Run torch.addmm with aliased out= and compare against a reference torch.addmm call without out= using the same inputs.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Expected output is the result of torch.addmm(bias, mat1, mat2) without aliasing; compare element-wise equality with the aliased result.
